findings.text: follow-on: the field's review, finding and disposition counts are read from the whole code-review store (list_code_reviews(project), never narrowed by the window) while treatments and product_lines are windowed, so a figure the docstring and section 10 both describe as 'for the window' is a lifetime total.

follow-on: _FOLDED_DISPOSITION_PREFIX = "folded:" re-states the disposition encoding finding_disposition (reckon/crew/findings.py:189) already owns, so this module forks the owner's format instead of extending it.
